ir.note: Six buttons: Input, Volume Up, Volume Down, Gain, Speaker/Headphone selector, Mute. Schiit are explicit that this is NOT the preamp remote: "it won't work with Freya and Saga. Nor will Freya and Saga remotes work with Ragnarok 2" (Ragnarok 2 manual, Remote Control). So a Ragnarok 2 sharing a room with a Saga or Freya does not collide with them, and a shared blaster is safe unless a second Ragnarok 2 is present.

metadata.notes: Modular integrated amp for speakers and headphones; takes Schiit Universal DAC and phono cards. Volume is a 128-step relay attenuator with a motorised pot that tracks the remote, so the front panel follows a command Lyr sends. The Gain button and the Speaker/Headphone selector are separate controls. Codes are not published by Schiit and must be captured from the remote. Icon: the generic amplifier chassis, not a Schiit fascia. This library's glyphs are pixel-measured off a straight-on front elevation, and Schiit publish only three-quarter renders (freyaplus-LISST-front-1920.jpg, kara-front-blk-1920.jpg are both in perspective), so a measured Freya/Saga/Kara fascia is still owed a square-on photograph.
